quests.title: Capturing Light and Shadow

dialogue.t: Alright, this should be the most critical step. Let's keep it up, {NICKNAME}!
As long as we use the power of the Streaming Projectors, we can completely restore the mural!
Voila! All done!
Seeing the Water Droplets so happy makes Paimon happy too!

dialogue.sit: We protected the essence of friendship.
We made the Water Droplets' wish come true.

dialogue.t: Now, both the painter's friends and their work in the Veluriyam Mirage are looking their best!
Maybe someday, that painter will return to visit their friends and look at their masterpiece!
Speaking of which, the style of this painting is pretty unique... Even though it's not that fancy, it's still beautiful!
And what's more important is that Paimon can understand it! Perhaps if Paimon imitates the style, she can also paint lovely yet understandable paintings!

dialogue.sit: Wanna learn how to paint that way, Paimon?

dialogue.t: Yes! And if it's okay with you, let's take a picture of this painting!
Then Paimon can study the painting whenever she likes!
Maybe once Paimon has also painted something that pretty, it'll attract lots of Water Droplets that want to be Paimon's friends!
Voila! All done!
Seeing Water Droplets so happy really gives Paimon a sense of achievement!

dialogue.sit: This mural is important to the Water Droplets.
There are still many stories about the painter and Water Droplets we don't know.

dialogue.t: Right! Based on their reaction, it seems the Water Droplets really care about the painter. We haven't collected all the diary fragments and read the painter's whole story...
If we have some extra time on our hands, we can explore the cave and find the rest of the diary fragments!
Speaking of which, the style of this painting is pretty unique... Even though it's not that fancy, it's still beautiful!
And what's more important is that Paimon can understand it! Perhaps if Paimon imitates the style, she can also paint lovely yet understandable paintings!

Then Paimon can study the painting whenever she likes!

quests.description: Following the tracks of a Choo-Choo Cart line, you and Paimon run into an enormous space in the cave with a mysterious mural in a very conspicuous spot, which seems to be illustrating someone’s story in the “Veluriyam Mirage”…
